messages:
zoe-cs: Merchantly just escalated a summarization regression that started after yesterday's 'latency-optimizations' rollout. They say bullet lists are being truncated and many outputs now start with "Note:" which they never had. Customer included an example and two request IDs.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rollouts/latency-optimizations v2.1.7 by ingrid at 1953360000

alex: @zoe-cs can you paste the request IDs + full prompt logs? need model, version, route, and the exact API payload (headers + body). Also which region/customer plan.

zoe-cs: customer gave these:
- request_id: rq_cust_9f3a
- request_id: rq_cust_9f3b
Model: rwd/gpt-like-13b
Route: /v1/generate
Timestamp (customer): 2026-03-15T02:12:14Z
Customer example (sanitized):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the meeting notes into bullet points:\n- Discussed pricing\n- Action items for Q2\n- Follow-ups"
Response: "Note: Here are the bullet points:\n- Pricing discussed\n- Action items for Q2"
```
They say previously response would be just the bullets, no leading 'Note:' and not dropping the last bullet.

maya: can you also include temperature, max_tokens, top_p from the request? temp often causes verbosity. If you can repro locally, try same params.

zoe-cs: headers/payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd/gpt-like-13b",
  "input": "<customer prompt>",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 200,
  "stop": ["\n\n"]
}
```

jr-support: I'll run a quick check on hosted using the exact payload and post outputs here.

ingrid: quick note — we flipped a post-processing flag in v2.1.7 called `summarize-cleanup: add_leadin_note` as part of the latency banner PR. I pushed the change to reduce tokenization passes. @maya @alex could that be injecting the 'Note:' prefix in some cases?

maya: ACK. That flag change matches the time window. If the post-process is failing on list parsing it could drop trailing list items. I'll run an A/B between v2.1.6 and v2.1.7 on the same prompt.

zoe-cs: customer replied: they can share full prompt logs but want us to redact user PII. They've uploaded sanitized logs to the shared folder: https://redwood.app/secure/merchantly-logs (internal link). Also confirmed regression started right after the rollout.

alex: thanks — I'll diff the model outputs and also check the post-process unit tests. If we confirm, recommend rolling that flag back or canary to v2.1.6 for Merchantly while we patch. @ops who needs to approve rollback?

jr-support: ran hosted test (same payload) — v2.1.7 output matches customer (leading 'Note:' + missing last bullet). v2.1.6 returns bullets only. Pasting both outputs:
```
v2.1.7: "Note: Here are the bullet points:\n- Pricing discussed\n- Action items for Q2"
v2.1.6: "- Pricing discussed\n- Action items for Q2\n- Follow-ups"
```

ingrid: OK strong repro. I'll open a rollback ticket and tag @ops. Also pushing a quick patch to skip 'add_leadin_note' for list-structured outputs.

zoe-cs: I'll update Merchantly with an ETA and ask for permission to canary rollback on their account. keeping them in the loop.

alex: good triage. Keep logs, request IDs, and the customer's sanitized prompt pinned to the ticket for the release notes/regression postmortem.
